entities.name: Query Nnr enzyme
observations: 496 aa protein with YjeF_N domain at positions 27–190 and Carb_kinase-like C-terminal domain at positions 252–479.
Close reviewed homologs B5YIM0, Q83CM5, and Q2RGI2 are annotated as bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes Nnr.
Homology is strong across 94–99% of the sequence, but exact activity remains a sequence-based inference for this query protein.

entities.name: Bifunctional Nnr
observations: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme with NAD(P)HX epimerase activity and ADP-dependent (S)-NAD(P)HX dehydratase activity.
Curated homolog annotations assign EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136.
The enzyme binds one potassium ion per subunit according to curated homolog annotations.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: This interconversion repairs the stereoisomeric forms of hydrated NADH and NADPH.

entities.name: ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: The reaction uses ADP, which is converted to AMP, to restore NADH or NADPH from the hydrated cofactor.
